title: Physical Design Manager
teaser: Seeking a Physical Design Manager to lead a team in developing high-quality VLSI designs from RTL to GDS. Oversee the full chip design lifecycle and provide strategic technical leadership. Ideal for experienced engineers with a strong background in VLSI backend design and proven management experience.
description:
Cisco Silicon One is seeking a Physical Design Manager.

Meet the Team

Physical Design team within Cisco Silicon One is responsible for the entire backend methodology and flow development from RTL to GDS. This is a critical part of the group leading the development of high-quality VLSI designs.

We demonstrate the latest silicon technologies and processes to build the largest-scale and most complex devices, pushing the boundaries of feasibility.

Your Impact
You'll be part of the Cisco Silicon One team, which is at the heart of Cisco’s software and ASIC design efforts.

As the Physical Design Manager, you will provide strategic and technical leadership to a team of engineers, guiding them through the entire chip design lifecycle. You will be responsible for the group's output, including Definition, Physical Synthesis, Place and Route, Optimization, Timing Closure, Design Floor Planning.

Minimum Qualifications 

·       A VLSI Design with extensive experience in backend design

·       B.Sc./M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.

·       Strong understanding of Place & Route flow.

·       10+ years of hands-on experience in a relevant domain

·       4+ years of proven Management or Technical Leadership experience.

Preferred Qualifications 

·       Deep understanding of all aspects of Physical construction and Integration.

·       Knowledge in Physical Design Verification methodology LVS/DRC.

·       Familiarity with physical design EDA tools (such as Synopsys, Cadence, etc.).
